snippet.title: Town of Zoz - Narrative Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
The new narrative trailer for Town of Zoz, a cooking/life sim with a dark twist. It's coming soon to PC, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow
